summary: Located to the northern fringe of Penrith, in an elevated setting with panoramic views to from the private rear garden over the town to the Lake District beyond, a recently built, freehold, well presented, 2 double bedroom, semi-detached home in a modern development, with no occupancy restrictions
description:
Built by respected local developers Atkinsons of Penrith, Chase Park is a popular modern development on the semi-rural northern edge of the town, combining a peaceful setting with excellent access to Penrith, the M6 and Carlisle.

Offered for sale on a wholly freehold basis, the property is ideal for first-time buyers, young professionals, downsizers or investors, this beautifully presented home has been thoughtfully designed for modern, low-maintenance living. It benefits from off-road parking with an EV charging point, while to the rear is a fully enclosed garden with a useful storage shed and an impressive elevated outlook. From here, you can enjoy far-reaching panoramic views across Penrith towards the spectacular Lake District fells, creating a wonderful space to relax or entertain.

Internally, the accommodation comprises an entrance hallway with a cloakroom/WC, a comfortable lounge and a contemporary kitchen/dining room with French doors opening directly onto the rear garden. Upstairs are two generous double bedrooms and a stylish family bathroom.

Offering a superb combination of quality, practicality and outstanding views, this is a home that is sure to appeal to a wide range of buyers.

Directions From the centre of Penrith follow the A6 north. Just before leaving the town turn right onto Salkeld Road and immediately left onto Inglewood Road. Follow this for 400 metres to reach Chase Park.

Services Mains gas, electric, water and drains are connected, but neither these services nor any boilers or radiators have been tested.
